verdict.rationale: Superhuman Mail does ship automations, including custom Auto Labels, Auto Archive, and trigger-based agents built via chat or a visual builder, so this axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains nothing on versioning, reviewing changes to, or rolling back those automations. Reviewing AI-generated drafts before sending is an adjacent feature: it reviews outputs, not automation definitions, and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
